content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: An environmental advocacy group has harshly criticized the mayor’s recently unveiled climate action plan, arguing that it falls short of addressing the urgent needs of the community.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: The mayor’s plan focuses on promoting renewable energy sources and expanding public transportation, but critics say it fails to address key issues like air quality and waste management.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: ‘While these are important steps, they do not go far enough to protect our environment and the health of our citizens,’ said Jane Doe, spokesperson for Green Future Coalition.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: Supporters of the plan counter that it represents a significant step forward and should be given time to implement fully.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: The city council is expected to review the plan in the coming months, with public input being sought during this process.
